scientific.integrity: The defining fixed-momentum randomized two-reflection recurrence is reduced exactly on a consistent orthonormal two-row system to an iid Bernoulli scalar multiplier; its three-dimensional second-moment operator is solved locally by analytic eigenvalue perturbation and at an explicit rational parameter pair by exact polynomial root isolation.
limitations: Two-row orthonormal homogeneous system, independent with-replacement sampling and two reflections per outer step.
Local-in-momentum theorem for a fixed relaxation; one explicit nonperturbative rational witness.
Actual expected squared error, not the norm of the expected iterate, and not wall-clock or globally optimal complexity.
Source bound remains valid but loose on the exhibited instance.

title: Underrelaxed randomized Douglas–Rachford gains mean-square acceleration from momentum
